_evidence: Text scripts for the interpreter 0x0054d798 ('pushal; push edi; push esi; call 0x509ec0 (ret 8, no-op); popal; call 0x54d1ad; call 0x54d7c0'). 0x54d1ad does esi = [0x835846 + 4*id]: the runtime string-pointer table (all zero in the image, filled by the text loaders 0x54cd69/0x54cfbd/0x54cfec/0x54d04c/0x54e426), so every entry a caller can select must point at readable text. Entries: ids 0..7 (0x835846..0x835865; the wrappers 0x545ec2 'esi=eax+0xba6' and 0x548987 'esi=eax+0xb90' with eax restricted to id-bias) and ids 0xba6..0xbbb = dwords 0x8386de..0x838732 (22 entries: 0x5489a6 takes k = 0x5484eb's driver-slot index in 0..10 ((0x16-ecx)>>1 in 0x5484f2) and loads ids 0xba6+k and 0xbb1+k; 0x8386de = 0x835846+4*0xba6, 0x83870a = 0x835846+4*0xbb1). Each entry points at its own 0x40-byte script (the scratch region beyond a buffer is mapped zero, so a run that reaches the end reads a NUL and stops). Script bytes, from 0x54d7c0: lodsb; 0 -> store NUL at [edi] and return; 4 -> 0x54d834 (digit parse that re-zeroes eax every iteration, so eax=0), then 'call [0x54d7ac+4*eax]' = handler 0x54d856, which loads [[0x833f1c]+0] - 0x833f1c is zero in the image and no instruction anywhere writes it (only reads at 0x54d856/0x54d86d), so byte 4 faults at 0x54d865 in every game state: excluded; 1..0x13 (not 4) -> dec esi; ecx = [0x833f98+4*b]; rep movsb (copies the opcode and its operands raw; the image's constant length table gives 2,2,3,-,2,2,2,1,1,1,1,1,1,3,3,5,1,3,3 for b=1..0x13 - all nonzero, so no zero-length re-read loop); >= 0x14 -> stosb (literal). So every byte except 4 is valid; the fill draws from 0, every copy-run opcode 1..3/5..0x13 and literals 0x14/0x20/0x41/0x7f/0x80/0xff. Output at edi is at most ~0x45 bytes per script (a 3- or 5-byte run at the end copies zeros from the gap) plus the NUL.
